label: Graphite Chrome
description: Warm charcoal with an ice-blue primary and chrome-amber accent. A workshop dark that is deliberately NOT near-black — built for car accessories, detailing studios and audio installers, whose photography is shot inside dark cars.
notes: Replaces an earlier near-black attempt that the customer rejected as too harsh. Background luminance is 0.0122 against that version's 0.0044 — nearly 3x lighter — so panels, borders and photo edges separate instead of dissolving into one black slab. Every text pairing clears WCAG AA: text/bg 15.41:1, muted/bg 7.70:1, accent/bg 10.11:1, primary/bg 7.88:1. `accent` matters most because the renderer paints 12px meta text with it, which is where every shipped automotive theme fails (octane primary 3.74:1, iron-blaze accent 3.82:1). Both primary and accent are light enough that SiteRenderer::readableOn() picks #111827 on buttons, giving 8.28:1 and 10.63:1. `secondary` is an elevated SURFACE here, not a text colour — measure text ON it, never it against bg. `border` and `surface` sit close to `bg` on purpose; a 3:1 divider on a dark theme reads as a harsh outline.
